hypothesis: Gemini 3.5 Flash at minimal thinking is a slower but more policy-consistent fast continuation than local no-thinking Qwen, while exact same-model continuation into high-thinking Gemini can improve final tool correctness and trajectory consistency.

candidate.continuity_to_slow: authenticated native state for the exact same model plus the portable trajectory

controlled_variables: all 278 base tasks in airline, retail, and telecom
seed 300 and one trial per task
Fish S2-Pro caller and agent voices
50 ms internal opportunities and 200 ms benchmark ticks
32-token fast bound and proposal-only fast tool authority
unconditional fast-to-slow continuation and slow-only tool-result resumption
single-GPU Fish/ASR co-location and max concurrency one
primary_outcomes: tau pass^1 overall and by domain
exact tool name and argument correctness
capability denial, contradiction, repeated acknowledgement, and repair turns
fast and slow provider latency, token use, and canceled work
local GPU memory, utilization, and queueing
hosted request count and reported usage
decision_rule: Report the paired Pareto frontier. Gemini fast is preferred only if complete cells improve task/tool and trajectory consistency enough to justify any first-response latency and hosted-compute regression; no task text or benchmark label may route between fast providers.
